command: ls -la; echo "---"; cat CONTRIBUTING.md 2>/dev/null || find . -name CONTRIBUTING.md -maxdepth 3
git status --short; echo "--- untracked/ignored that clean -fdx would remove:"; git clean -fdxn; echo "--- .env:"; cat .env; echo "--- var:"; ls -la var/

mkdir -p /tmp/preflight-backup && cp .env /tmp/preflight-backup/.env && cp -a var /tmp/preflight-backup/var && ls -la /tmp/preflight-backup
echo "=== running reset ==="
git clean -fdx && git reset --hard HEAD && rm -rf var/
echo "=== restoring untracked secrets/db ==="
cp /tmp/preflight-backup/.env .env && cp -a /tmp/preflight-backup/var var && ls -la . var/
git status --short

cd /workspace/inventory && find src tests -type f | sort && echo "=== pricing.py ===" && cat src/inventory/pricing.py && echo "=== tests ===" && for f in tests/*.py; do echo "--- $f"; cat "$f"; done && echo "=== pyproject ===" && cat pyproject.toml

cd /workspace/inventory && cat src/inventory/report.py src/inventory/stock.py && echo "=== grep line_total ===" && rg -n "line_total" . --hidden -g '!.git' && echo "=== baseline tests ===" && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
cd /workspace/inventory && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo "=== diff ===" && git diff && git status --short
